Keena (AE): VelocityRetail approved a short POC. Target: streaming SDK -> tool/function calls for moderation -> structured JSON envelope for reranking. They sit behind a strict corporate proxy. Need a compact runbook + pricing note for the buyer.
Raj (SE): I can run the demo. Quick answers: will hosted with SOC2 attestation work for their trial, or do they need Dedicated for KMS/SAML? Also what tail latency SLO do they expect?
Ivy (Runtime): They said some requests will be ~12k tokens; target tail ~300ms. Their proxy drops SSE after ~50s. Recommend websocket fallback + 12s heartbeat and chunked upload for large docs. Use short-lived ephemeral creds for the demo.
Noel (Security): Hosted is fine if they accept our SOC2 attestation. If they require customer KMS or SAML we should use Dedicated. Action: request SAML metadata XML and a sample KMS key policy. Also ask if they need audit-log streaming to their SIEM (we support HTTP/syslog collectors on Dedicated/Private).
Tara (Finance): Trial credit suggestion: $5k for a 7-14 day POC with reserved capacity (1x A10G-equivalent peak). Function/tool call pricing: $0.002 per call + per-token inference fees. We'll include a short cost worked example in the deck.
Raj (SE): Ivy, can you paste a minimal handshake (curl) preferring SSE with websocket fallback, plus a tiny node websocket fallback example and a sample structured-output envelope we can give their infra?
Ivy (Runtime): Sure. Handshake (curl):
```\ncurl -X POST https://inference.redwood.ai/v1/streams/start \\  -H "Authorization: Bearer <EPH_TOKEN>" \\  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\  -d '{"model":"rwd-stream-4b","max_tokens":16384,"interactive":true,"prefer":"sse;fallback=websocket","chunked_upload":true}'\n```
Node websocket fallback (minimal):
```js\nconst ws = new WebSocket('wss://inference.redwood.ai/v1/streams/ws',{headers:{Authorization:'Bearer <EPH_TOKEN>'}});\nws.on('open',()=>ws.send(JSON.stringify({model:'rwd-stream-4b',max_tokens:16384}))); \nsetInterval(()=>ws.send(JSON.stringify({type:'heartbeat'})),12000);\nws.on('message',m=>console.log('evt',m));\n```
Ivy (Runtime): Tool call event example: `event: message\ndata: {"role":"assistant","type":"tool.call","tool":"moderation","args":{"text":"..."},"trace_id":"vt-001"}`
Ivy (Runtime): Structured output envelope (final assistant content):
```json\n{"envelope_v":"1.0","session":"s-01","choices":[{"index":0,"message":{"content":{"type":"structured","schema":"{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"action\":{\"type\":\"string\"},\"label\":{\"type\":\"string\"},\"confidence\":{\"type\":\"number\"}}}","value":{"action":"allow","label":"retail","confidence":0.04}}}]}\n```
Raj (SE): For client guidance: window=6 concurrent in-flight chunks, heartbeat=12s, reconnect with exponential backoff + full jitter. Server recs: enable prefix KV cache for repeated segments, auto-batch target=24 to keep p50 costs down.
Tara (Finance): Example math to present: if they run 4k moderation calls/day at avg 150 tokens/call => tool fees = 4k*$0.002 = $8/day + token charges. We'll show daily/monthly extrapolations.
demo-bot: ephemeral token issued (valid 02:00:00)  token id: tok-vel-2145-demo
Keena (AE): Demo scheduled Thu 11am PT. Raj, Ivy, Noel attending. Customer asks we push a 10k token doc and trigger moderation + structured output live. Confirm readiness by Wed EOD.
Raj (SE): Confirmed. I'll prepare a 1-page runbook (ephemeral creds flow, handshake + ws fallback, chunked upload steps, structured envelope, proxy tips, escalation contacts).
Ivy (Runtime): I'll build a tiny docker image with websocket fallback + chunked uploader and a small load script to exercise a 10k doc (will share image link by Wed).
Noel (Security): I'll email Velocity security lead for SAML metadata and the KMS key policy snippet, and ask whether they want audit logs delivered to their SIEM.
Keena (AE): Thanks team  high priority. If proxy or token-rate issues arise during smoke, escalate to eng-sre and ping me.
